OUR COLLECTION

WHY BER HONEY

Dark amber nectar from ber blossoms.

Ber (jujube) honey is gathered during the seasonal bloom of ber trees. Known for its deep amber colour and unmistakable richness, it offers a full-bodied sweetness that stands apart from lighter floral honeys.

  • Rich dark-amber tone with a smooth, lingering finish.
  • Distinctive, bold flavour from seasonal ber blossoms.
  • Carefully jarred to preserve its natural texture and aroma.

Frequently Asked Questions

We deliver all over Pakistan. Standard delivery usually takes 3–4 working days depending on your city. You will receive confirmation on WhatsApp once dispatched.
We currently accept Cash on Delivery, Bank Transfer, Easypaisa, and JazzCash. Message us on WhatsApp if you need payment details before placing your order.
Keep the jar tightly sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Always use a clean, dry spoon and avoid storing honey in the refrigerator.
Natural honey can thicken or form fine crystals over time depending on room temperature and floral nectar balance. If you prefer it pourable, place the closed jar in a bowl of warm (not boiling) water for a few minutes.
